Al Jazira for Imdad Smart Company (formerly known as IMDAD Group) is a leading name in the MEP construction sector in the Gulf region. With over 45 years of proven experience, the company continues to specialize in Mechanical and Electrical construction, offering complete, collaborative, and end-to-end solutions that bring life to new buildings and sustain existing ones.

Starting as IMDAD sanitary works in KSA, the company diversified and constantly followed the market. For over 45 years, the team has been reinforcing its international presence in the Gulf, expanding its in-house expertise and enlarging its scope of MEP Engineering services.
“Developing and serving society with the highest levels of professional integrity and commitment.”
Nearly five decades of building trust, delivering quality, and exceeding expectations across the Gulf region.
Nearly five decades of deep expertise operating across Gulf markets, understanding local requirements and international standards.
Over 100 completed projects with a reputation for exceptional performance and dependable specialist MEP contracting.
Strong reputation for quality, reliability, and timely delivery — strictly conforming to international standards.
85% of MEP work is self-performed by our in-house engineers, minimizing risks and ensuring consistent quality.
The purpose behind every project we deliver — and where we are heading next.
To safely deliver world-class Quality MEP projects and infrastructure projects on time, promoting environmental protection and sustainable community development.
Engineering Excellence — Providing comprehensive and effective solutions across all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works.
Safety First — Strictly following occupational health and safety standards to protect individuals and assets at all sites.
Sustainability — Implementing eco-friendly solutions that reduce energy consumption and contribute to sustainable community development.
Customer Focus — Understanding client needs and adapting services to ensure full satisfaction with tailored solutions.
Innovation — Developing innovative technologies and solutions to enhance project efficiency without compromising quality.

To become a regional market leader in the MEP Construction Industry, providing engineering excellence to valued clients through commitment to delivering best practices in corporate governance and transparency.
Expanding Core Competencies — Strengthening our electro-mechanical capabilities and broadening our multi-disciplined EPIC service portfolio.
Unique Technologies — Identifying and producing unique technologies that set us apart and deliver innovative solutions for our clients.
Strategic Partnerships — Aligning with key partners that enhance our capabilities to produce and distribute cutting-edge engineering ideas.

With over 45 years of electro-mechanical construction experience across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, IMDAD has successfully delivered landmark MEP projects ranging from 32-floor luxury hotel towers to mission-critical data centers and university campuses.

Our in-house team self-performs 85% of MEP works including HVAC, high/low voltage electrical, fire suppression, and smart automation systems — ensuring unmatched execution quality and schedule compliance.
